text:
Priya (Design): uploaded an alternate row-focused prototype for prompt-sets/evals. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/row-variant-evals?node-id=1:2
Priya (Design): core idea: single-column compact rows, left-aligned metadata, right side small action cluster. rows expand inline; bulk toolbar sticks to top. looking for quick feedback on affordances + copy.
Omar (Product): I like the single-column for scanning. question: how do we surface frequency of regressions over time? users asked for a quick history indicator.
Priya (Design): added a mini sparklines column with 3-point history (last 3 runs) and a hover tooltip for more.
Lee (Frontend): perf note: variable row heights + virtualization can be tricky. prefer measuring heights and reindexing after expand. also icon hit targets need 44px min for touch.
Nadia (Accessibility): a11y checklist: rows should be buttons for expand, icon actions must be real buttons, aria-expanded on rows. contrast check: the amber severity chip on white fails at 12px.
Sam (UX Research): in the lab, participants liked inline accept/reject but wanted a confirmation to avoid mistakes. recommend inline confirm + undo toast. also users wanted a less alarming label than "regressed".
Priya (Design): swapping copy: "regressed" -> "quality change" per Sam. bulk action label: "Accept selected runs" vs "Approve"?
Omar (Product): prefer "Accept"—clearer for outputs. also add a small history icon that opens run timeline in a side panel.
Lee (Frontend): quick pseudo:
```jsx
<Row role=\"listitem\" tabIndex={0} aria-expanded={expanded}>
  <LeftMeta />
  <SummaryButton onClick={toggle}/>
  <ActionGroup>
    <IconButton aria-label=\"Accept output\" onClick={accept}/>
    <IconButton aria-label=\"View timeline\" onClick={openTimeline}/>
  </ActionGroup>
  <Expander hidden={!expanded}><DiffPreview/></Expander>
</Row>
```
Lee (Frontend): will also add skip-to-results anchor and keyboard shortcut (/) to focus search.
Nadia (Accessibility): ensure toast uses role=\"status\" and Undo is keyboard-focusable. provide SR text: "Run accepted. Undo". also color alternatives for the sparkline (use pattern or +/- icon).
lighthouse-bot: CI results for branch feat/row-variant: 
```naxe: color-contrast (SeverityChip)  contrast 2.1:1
eslint: jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions in RowSummary
```
Priya (Design): noted, I'll update chip color and change summary wrapper to a button.
Sam (UX Research): small copy nuance: for confirmation modal, use "This will mark X runs as accepted. You can undo from the activity history." users liked actionable reassurance.
Omar (Product): also log that we need an audit event for accept actions for compliance.
Priya (Design): added to spec. planning to push updated frames in 3 hours. thanks! :clap:
